title: Florida Student Aid Website Hack Puts Data of 4.9 Million People at Risk
description: The Florida Department of Education's student financial aid website was breached, potentially exposing personal data of approximately 4.9 million individuals. The compromised data may include names, Social Security numbers, dates of birth, addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, and gender codes. The breach was discovered on October 19, 2026, and has since been contained. The department has not disclosed the attack vector or threat actor. Existing student aid and disbursements remain unaffected.
